instruction: For each product, compute its share of the zone's total sales as a percentage (rounded to one decimal), and add this value in a new column.

metadata.explanation: Task requires calculating the percentage each product represents of its zone's total sales. Verified with Python: Zone 1 total=36323 (Khewra Salt=14451/36323=39.8%, Lahori Paye=10781/36323=29.7%, Nihari=11091/36323=30.5%), Zone 2 total=36619 (Chapli Kebab=13363/36619=36.5%, Biryani=9960/36619=27.2%, Sajji=13296/36619=36.3%), Zone 3 total=42966 (Sohan Halwa=11175/42966=26.0%, Nan Khatai=16530/42966=38.5%, Gajrela=15261/42966=35.5%). Evaluator checks all 9 percentages with 0.2% tolerance.

Correct expected values: All 9 percentages match calculations from metadata (e.g., 14451/36323=39.8%)
Proper postconfig: Activates Calc window and saves file with Ctrl+S to ensure values are persisted before reading
